_comment: 27 Jul 2026: the professional/regulatory body sweep, card A. Every URL here passed BOTH the terms-of-use + robots.txt check (same discipline lawwatch.mjs applies to ALLOWED_HOSTS) AND a second, separate pass: fetched and read, by a human proxy, to confirm the page is real substantive on-topic guidance and not a 404, a landing/navigation shell, or the wrong topic. sources.json taught us this the hard way once already with the MTD redirect; this file's FIRST draft repeated the exact same mistake on 10 of 11 URLs, caught only when the dry run was actually run for real and every 'successful' fetch was read back. WHEN YOU ADD A SOURCE, OPEN IT AND CHECK THE FIGURE IS ON IT. Every source below was opened and the figure, or the rule, is actually on it.

_excluded.name: FCA
_excluded.reason: terms explicitly prohibit bots/scrapers/automated monitoring without prior written consent; same reasoning Khoji already applies to exclude the Find Case Law API.

_excluded.name: OPBAS
_excluded.reason: hosted on fca.org.uk, same prohibition applies.

_excluded.name: ICAEW Tax Faculty
_excluded.reason: the actual guidance (TAXguides) is members-only, behind login. Nothing public worth watching.

_excluded.name: AAT
_excluded.reason: terms explicitly state 'this includes the prohibition of data-scraping'. Unambiguous no.

_excluded.name: ICAS
_excluded.reason: robots.txt explicitly names and blocks anthropic-ai, Claude-Web, GPTBot, CCBot and others. An explicit anti-AI-crawler stance should be respected, not routed around under a different user agent.

_excluded.name: NICEIC
_excluded.reason: robots.txt (Content-Signal format) explicitly disallows ClaudeBot, GPTBot, Google-Extended, CCBot and others by name. Same reasoning as ICAS.

_excluded.name: CIOT
_excluded.reason: terms-and-conditions page returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches (confirmed on two separate attempts), so the actual clause could not be read. Needs a real-browser check before it can be added.

_excluded.name: ACCA
_excluded.reason: broad 'no reproduction or storage without ACCA's prior written permission' clause, no automated-access carve-out. Needs a legal sign-off, not assumed clean.

_excluded.name: IFA
_excluded.reason: robots.txt fetch was blocked (403) rather than confirmed absent, mirroring CIOT's pattern. Needs a real-browser check.

_excluded.name: Gas Safe Register
_excluded.reason: terms-of-use page returned 403 to automated fetch; robots.txt looked fine but the clause itself is unconfirmed.

_excluded.name: TrustMark
_excluded.reason: robots.txt could not be retrieved; terms language on reproduction is broad. Needs verification.

_excluded.name: The Pensions Regulator
_excluded.reason: does not claim OGL despite the .gov.uk domain, unlike HSE/ACAS which do explicitly. Needs a licence confirmation before relying on it.

_excluded.name: GLAA
_excluded.reason: gla.gov.uk now redirects to the new Fair Work Agency's gov.uk page following the April 2026 transfer of functions; the FWA's gov.uk page is already covered by the core gov.uk watch, nothing distinct to add here.

_excluded.name: NCA
_excluded.reason: no page on nationalcrimeagency.gov.uk itself is real small-business-facing AML guidance; every candidate read as a landing page pointing at the SAR portal. The actual guidance a tradesperson-adjacent 'high value dealer' would need (registration, thresholds, risk factors) lives on gov.uk under HMRC's economic crime supervision handbook, already covered by the core gov.uk watch. Nothing distinct to add here, same reasoning as GLAA.

_excluded.name: Small Business Commissioner
_excluded.reason: the original /late-payments/ URL turned out to be a mental-health-support page, not late payment rules. Every other page checked (Legal Action for Late Payments, Late Payments Consultation Guidance, FAQs) is procedural (how to raise a complaint, how to sue) rather than the substantive law (the Late Payment of Commercial Debts Act, the statutory interest rate). That substantive law already lives on gov.uk / legislation.gov.uk, covered by the existing watches. Dropped rather than watch a page with nothing on it.

_excluded.name: ICB (Institute of Certified Bookkeepers)
_excluded.reason: the original /Membership/Compliance URL was a 404 rendered with a 200 status. No replacement public guidance page was found on bookkeepers.org.uk; its real content appears to be members-only. Dropped rather than force a weak source in.
